hypothesis: The CLR root of owner world RGD differs from the exact original Save argument type but may be an authenticated derived RGD assignable to the original Save(string,RGD) base parameter.

decisive_refinement: The first source-authentic CI42153104453 used a too strict exact concrete root type equality and safely refused all seven; not a save incompatibility result.
Previous T4 original IL audits (CI42062124798, CI42068520588) established SaveWorld uses an RGD-derived local/factory result, motivating CLR inheritance-aware preflight.

New preflight requires actual CLR declaring assembly identity plus argument Source RGD and IsAssignableFrom(owner-world derived type), and rechecks the reflected real original method parameter assignability immediately before invocation.
With those guards, original private Save and original generic LoadT actually succeed 7 of 7; this corrects the earlier over-restrictive type test, not a rewrite of the game.
